pages.title: Plasma Injection Nozzle
pages.text: A nozzle that fires plasma into a confinement chamber at a precisely controlled rate. Magnetic confinement steers it, a cryocooler keeps the coils cold, and the tip glows white when in use. The air around the tip crackles.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding plasma into a nucleosynthesis chamber needs precision. I fitted a plasma nozzle tip into magnetic confinement casing with a superconducting coil block and a cryocooler, and the plasma went exactly where I aimed.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Nucleosynthesis Chamber.
